scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison from advertised format/version claims to exact parser, carrier, projection, writer, and downstream-consumer operations, then refine existing 3D plan gates.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and local plan cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing S2/S3/S5/S8 owners, carrier/semantic separation, comparator admission, FreeCAD workflow, and fast-versus-composed validation policy
DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md: current FreeCAD, ACIS/ACDS, and optional modeler-consumer gates
method.evidenceRule: Mutable project documentation and issue responses describe their stated route only; source presence or advertised format support is not an exact-build runtime result. Separate parser acceptance, raw payload retention, graph closure, projection/rendering, semantic geometry, and native application behavior. Keep peer artifact, operation, input/output, backend, and expected-value provenance explicit.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG aggregate claims do not define one DWG writer/reader profile
evidence.observed: The public README broadly describes all-version reading while qualifying advanced R2010+ objects as skipped. Its writer summary and build-option text give different boundaries. The current R2007+ decoder contains a named read_2007_section_acds path, but that source presence does not establish complete ACDS decoding, entity-to-payload ownership association, semantic-body delivery, or conversion preservation.
doesNotEstablish: a pinned release's behavior on a particular input and output version
complete AcDs directory/schema interpretation or modeler ownership closure
successful modeler carrier conversion or valid B-rep geometry
that an open-source peer result independently resolves ODA specification ambiguities
evidence.planUse: For peer comparison, record exact source/release/build, actual input/output versions, operation, object/section disposition, diagnostics, and output hashes. For AcDs, separately compare section bytes, per-modeler owner/key association, emitted DXF carrier, and independent semantic result.

evidence.topic: ezdxf ACIS structural, raw-carrier, and visualization operations are distinct
evidence.observed: The documented ACIS parser supports a limited entity subset; unsupported records become NONE_ENTITY and lose data on export. browse-acis exposes and exports raw SAT/SAB. The drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D engine, so 3D entities are projected into XY.
evidence.planUse: Use a pinned ezdxf run only as a matching-profile parser/raw-carrier control and count unsupported/lost entities. Do not use audit/recovery, mesh projection, draw output, or visual appearance as ACIS semantic evidence.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD stock DWG/DXF route and ACIS consumer boundary
evidence.observed: The documented stock DWG workflow converts DWG to DXF and then applies the selected DXF importer limitations. The documentation identifies CAD Exchanger as its 3D DWG workflow, while a maintainer response says the stock FOSS route cannot read proprietary ACIS blobs. These are source/documentation boundaries, not guarantees for every plugin, backend, release, or platform.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of every FreeCAD importer/backend tuple
ACIS semantic acceptance through the stock converter-to-DXF route
ACDS ownership or history-graph correctness through CAD Exchanger
that a converter's successful output file is a successfully imported solid
evidence.planUse: Keep native Linux/Windows stock FreeCAD checks focused on converter discovery, exact handoff, packaging, and named explicit-entity results. Record stock ACIS as CONSUMER_NOT_APPLICABLE. Treat CAD Exchanger or another modeler plugin as a separately named optional route, requiring exact build/license, source-to-DXF inventory, units, shape validity, and independent expected metrics; it does not qualify the DWG AcDs graph.
